title: You have a second brain in your gut

lines.text: You have a second brain, and it's in your gut.
It's called the enteric nervous system, a web of nerves lining your digestive tract.
And it can run your digestion on its own, even when its main nerve link to the brain is cut.
More than 90% of your body's serotonin is found in your gut.

visual.label: of your serotonin is in the gut

lines.text: In the brain, serotonin helps regulate mood. In the gut, it helps keep things moving.
Scientists are still mapping how these two brains talk to each other.
So next time you get a gut feeling, it might not just be a figure of speech.
